text_block_list.text:
Today, I visited a deserted island with
Tap Dance City to participate in a project.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"'Battle for the Buried Treasure of Pirate Island'!!
This is getting exciting, Trainer!"
choice_data_list: Isn't wearing your racing outfit a bit overzealous...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Well, of course you'd get fired up! A hidden treasure smells like nothing but pure "romance"!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Having said that,
it looks like there's plenty of competition.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
“Ah~ let us seek the hidden treasure together~♪
And seize glorious victory, my sworn ally~♪”

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Maya-Maya☆Marvelous♪♪
Let's snatch the treasure before anyone else~★

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
This two-person team scramble...
I'm counting on your strength!

While pairs of Umamusume stood out everywhere, her partner was me... Someone far inferior in athletic ability.
That's precisely why we had to demonstrate teamwork.
choice_data_list: I'll support you with everything I've got!
I'll support you with all my heart!

text_block_list.name: Female Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the treasure left behind by the Great Pirate!
The adventurers have now set forth!
First, what we need is to gather information on what's on this island. To that end, I headed for high ground overlooking the area, but—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So this is the summit!
Time to search for treasure... is what I'd like to say, but.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: First, we take a break! You look like you're about to drop. Let's cool off by that waterfall and shake off the fatigue from hiking up the mountain.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, I was just looking to take a breather myself.
Let's enjoy this stunning view for a little bit!

From the high vantage point, I could see only one paved road.
In that case, there must be something at the end of it!

She tried to make up for the time lost while resting...
but in her rush, she lost her balance—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hup, there!
You hurt at all, Trainer?

"The harder I tried, the more my efforts went nowhere.
Just as I was crushed under the weight of my own uselessness..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Wait.
Someone's gathering over there.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"‘My homeland, the beginning of a boundless journey.
Deep within, I shall leave my secret treasure.’
...Hmm, what a poetic monument!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Umm... As in the Great Pirate's hometown...?
I wonder where that could be...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Huh, riddles...? I'm throwing in the towel!
I don't get this at all!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any leads?
Lead the way. Let's move forward!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: This place is... where we first came, right?

The home of a Great Pirate is the "sea."
If the endless journey is a "sea route,"
then the place to aim for is the origin point that connects to the sea.

Looking down from the high ground, there's only
one body of water connected to the sea. And that is—this waterfall right before our eyes!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Over here, over here~! Maya's got a feeling about this!
Full speed ahead toward the treasure~☆

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, looks like we don't have time to lounge around.
So, what should we do?

I know it's a reckless suggestion.
Given my string of failures, it's only natural that you wouldn't trust me—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: What, is that all it was?!
Putting her arm around my shoulders, Tap Dance City dived straight into the raging torrent!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Gasp! Haha, what a surprise!
To think it connected somewhere else right behind the waterfall!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
This place is...! A hidden location!
There's definitely "secret treasure" around here somewhere!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Looks like your read was spot on!
As expected of my navigator!
choice_data_list: ...To think you'd dive right in without hesitating...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
? What a strange thing to say.
You're the one who suggested diving in, aren't you?

"Indeed, as an organized event, I was confident
that safety had been ensured.
However—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Not one bit! Because if you say so, I know it'll be fine!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
How can you chase a 'dream' if you can't
even believe in your friends?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Much less when you're my Trainer... I'd gladly trust you with my life!
choice_data_list: What kind of treasure should we go search for next?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Of course it is!
Because I need you!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The "romance" I seek
is far grander than any Pirate King's treasure.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare leave my right arm's side, got it?
My dearest... Navigator!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
! Haha, I like the sound of that!
That's my Trainer for ya.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Gold bullion hidden in a jungle temple, or perhaps jewels slumbering in an ancient castle overseas—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Even this very world!
Let's take it all for ourselves, together!
